headline: Border Ledger Shows Renewed Front-Line Churn
war_summary: The latest ledger records a fresh round of movement on several fronts. Nevish Line has resumed activity, with three ownership events in two hours and 45 across the day; its eight strategic bases are now Colonial-held. Linn Mercy is quieter than the previous edition but still shows one event in two hours, three in six, and 34 in 24, with ten Colonial bases and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has likewise eased from its earlier pace, though one event in two hours and 30 in the day leave seven Warden bases and two neutral. Marban Hollow has quickened, posting two events in two hours and 18 in 24, while its ledger remains divided among two Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases. Callums Cape is the sharpest immediate flashpoint by recent activity, with seven events in two hours, thirteen across the day, and accelerating Warden casualties and enlistments. Callahans Passage has gone quiet recently despite 19 events in 24 hours. Mooring County shows heavy, accelerating casualty rates but no ownership event in the latest two hours.
